ask: A Month option in the calendar's Show menu, so you can see a whole month at once.

demo.scope: Timeline Studio's calendar view only. A fixture for demo-viz: past work (3c303d1), re-run as if just finished.

personas.who: Planner looking a month ahead in the calendar

before.text: Steps week by week with the arrows, one week on screen at a time.
before.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 60" role="img" aria-label="A month grid"><rect x="4" y="4" width="192" height="52" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#8b93a7"/></svg>

after.text: Show has Month: the whole month on one screen, and a full day says how much more it holds.

assumptions.text: Weeks start on the plan's own week start, as the Week view's do.

examples.text: Show has a Month option: the whole month in whole weeks from the plan's week start, the days either side greyed.
Each day lists what's on it like the Week view does, in time order; something running past midnight shows on both days.
A day too full to fit says +N more; that, or the day's number, opens the day.
‹ and › (and the arrow keys) step a whole month.
Zoom still shows in Month, where there are no hours to zoom.

plan.step: Add Month to Show and draw it from the Week view's pieces.
